_comment: 2026-10-07: applied the 2026-09-21 review (docs/strategy_review_2026-09-21.md section 6). Live strategy is still mean reversion (trader.py). Watchlist widened 5 -> 32 coins (every non-stablecoin Kraken USD pair with Alpaca backtest history; PAXG excluded as gold-pegged). stop_loss_pct 4 -> 10 because the 4% stop sat inside normal 15-minute noise: every loss was exactly -5.57% vs ~+1.3% avg wins, so expectancy was about -0.9%/trade over 25 live round trips. Trend filter OFF (trend_tolerance_pct 100) - it blocked the deepest dips, which were the best entries; it was crash protection, so 12 is the fallback if a sustained crash shows up. Sizing 2%x12% -> 1%x20% (20 slots) so longer-held positions don't block new entries. Positions opened before this change keep their original 4% stop. Expected per the review: roughly break-even, ~80-90% of days with a trade - NOT a proven edge. Momentum params below are unused by trader.py.
